meta.title: Order Activity records participants added after publish
gaps: Verify that the Order Activity drawer contains a new entry specifically for the participant added after publish, including who added it and the date and time.
Verify that activity lines are in chronological order and that no earlier activity is missing.

steps.note: Open the buyer event creation flow.
Provide the required event title so the event can be published.
Apply a pricing template before adding line items.
Add the required event line item.
Complete the pricing sheet for the line item.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Invite the initial participant required for publication.
Publish the event so a participant can be added afterward.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Open the published stage's Participants list to add a participant after publication.
Add another QA vendor after publication, which is the activity being audited.
Confirm the newly added participant appears in the published stage's participant list.
Open the stage Order Activity drawer after the participant addition.
Confirm the Order Activity drawer is open and exposes the activity view.
Confirm the activity drawer contains an earlier event-history entry, providing a basic check that prior activity is retained.
